title: HackerRank: Picking Numbers
description: Given an array of integers `a`, find the maximum length of a subarray where the absolute difference between any two elements is less than or equal to 1.
solution:
def picking_numbers(a: list[int]) -> int:
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(a)
    max_len = 0
    for k in counts:
        max_len = max(max_len, counts[k] + counts[k + 1])
    return max_len
explanation: Any valid set can contain only numbers x and x + 1. Summing counts[k] + counts[k + 1] finds the longest subset in O(N) time.
